visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a green utility jacket sits at a long white office table, using a utility knife to cut through the tape on a large brown shipping box. Three other men are visible in the background, sitting at the table with laptops, watching him with anticipation. The room is brightly lit with white walls featuring text like 'INSPIRE' and 'BELIEVE'. (2) He opens the box flaps to reveal a white inner package. He looks at the camera and smiles, speaking excitedly. The background shows a modern office environment with whiteboards and a glass door. (3) He reaches into the large box and begins pulling out individual small white boxes. His colleagues laugh and lean in to see. One colleague in a grey hoodie and cap watches closely. (4) The man stacks ten white boxes, which are clearly Apple AirPods Pro packages, on the table. He gestures toward them with pride. A yellow text overlay at the bottom summarizes the action. (5) He starts distributing the white boxes to his team members. A man in a blue robe-like jacket receives one and holds it up to his face with a wide grin. Another man in a plaid shirt raises his box above his head in celebration. (6) The camera pans to show more team members, including a woman with long dark hair, holding their new devices. People are using their smartphones to record the moment. (7) The main man holds two AirPods boxes close to his face, laughing as he talks to the camera. His watch is visible on his left wrist. (8) Close-up on several hands opening the white boxes. They peel off the plastic seals and open the lids to see the charging cases inside. (9) A close-up shot shows the back of a white AirPods charging case with the word 'CAMPFIRE' neatly engraved on it. The man explains the engraving to the group as they all examine their new earbuds.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in a casual, conversational tone in Mandarin. There is a distinct, sharp 'zip' sound as a utility knife slices through cardboard, followed by the low-frequency thud of the box being placed. The room has a slight echo characteristic of an office space. (2) The speaker's volume increases as he starts narrating to the camera with high arousal. Background chatter and light laughter from other males are audible, creating a festive atmosphere. No BGM is present. (3) Sounds of cardboard flaps rustling and the percussive sliding of boxes against each other. Multiple voices overlap in a 'small group' chatter style, with occasional high-pitched bursts of laughter. (4) The main speaker delivers a more structured explanation, his voice clear and projected. He emphasizes the words 'Apple' and 'AirPods' while explaining the business account purchase. (5) A sudden swell in volume occurs as the group erupts in collective cheering and 'Woah' sounds. The intensity of vocal arousal is high. This is punctuated by the crinkling of plastic packaging being handled as units are distributed. (6) The audio becomes a mix of individual reactions; some people are cheering 'Yay,' while others are talking rapidly in the background. The speech density is high. (7) The main speaker tells a joke about his wife and snoring, followed by a loud, genuine laugh from himself and others. The pitch of his voice rises during the punchline. (8) Sounds of fine motor movements: the 'click' of the AirPods case opening and the soft rustle of paper manuals being inspected. (9) The main speaker's tone shifts to a more explanatory delivery as he discusses the 'CAMPFIRE' engraving. The video ends with a final, synchronized group cheer.
